protocol.session: NY09:30 regular open; official holidays and13:00 early closes
protocol.entry_clock: after opening30min; before session open+5h and close-30min
protocol.atr: last14 active regular-session true ranges, including intersession gaps
protocol.vwap: native trade typical15m-bar price weighted by native contract volume, not underlying consolidated VWAP
protocol.macro: QQQ andSPY same-session trade-return/weighted-price context, omit self, reverse SOXS exposure
protocol.target2: clip(2.5ATR,1%,2%), cap at known opposing range/prior-session levels
protocol.tick_grid: actual frozen exact contract; production rounding
protocol.crypto_reference: frozen crypto proposals with pre-entry12/16 activity, checked BE-atTP1; fixed across stock routes
protocol.stock_cash_gate: last20 closed nominal50% paper outcomes positive in both R and price return
protocol.choose_stock: positive stock monthly contribution and>=20stock closes across both TP1 modes and priorities; trade trigger only
protocol.joint_requirement: same positive/count test for both bots; this is a research prerequisite, not the30% objective
protocol.later: only selected stock case; fresh October paper/cash account, no earlier cash seed

limitations: Previously inspected history/current-snapshot universe; no independent holdout or historical investable universe.
Native volume-weighted typical15m price is not real consolidated stock VWAP or executable book.
Regular cash calendar is a strategy context; X-Perp availability and holidays differ.
SOXS inverse sign handled; QQQ/SPY are imperfect proxies for sector/single-stock and leverage risk.
Actual current contracts/ticks/lots assumed historically; macro quote freshness within bar and bid/ask not reconstructed.
Unknown raw stock path makes that selection case unscorable; never dropped or assigned zero PnL.
Paper readiness nominal50% is proposed signal health; private5% or minimum50% cash uses real lot rounding.
Cash starts fresh August and laterOctober; no floating-equity guard,funding,fees,liquidation or private fills.
Crypto activity/checked-BE reference is research, not a newly deployed strategy; stock LIVE restriction unchanged.
November partial; positive/count gate is a prerequisite, not proof of30% each bot each month.
